'''Pauling''' was a [[Gender/Legends|man]] who served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
Pauling was a crew member aboard the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Vector (Star Destroyer)|''Vector'']] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], when it was sent to transport a sample of the [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|blackwing virus]] to the world [[Khonji Seven]]. However, the virus leaked out, causing the majority of the ship's crew to turn into [[Zombie/Legends|zombies]]. Pauling and 29 of the other crew members took shelter inside the [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]] [[Freebird (Sentinel-class)|''Freebird'']], in the Destroyer's [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay. However, they were unable to leave the ''Vector'', as the zombies had activated the ship's [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]].

Pauling and the other crew members turned to [[cannibalism]] to survive. Ten weeks later, only Pauling and six others were left alive, when [[Jareth Sartoris]], a crew member from the [[Imperial prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']], took shelter inside the ''Freebird''. Some of the crew members tried to subdue Sartoris, so that they could eat him. However, Sartoris threw them out of a hatch and into the hangar, where they were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the zombies. He spared Pauling and two others, [[White (soldier)|White]] and [[Tanner]], promising them that he would go and turn off the tractor beam, then return and help them leave the ''Vector''.

The [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] succeeded in turning off the tractor beam and Sartoris told them about the surviviors aboard the ''Freebird'', shortly before he himself was killed. White left the shuttle and was killed saving [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Zahara Cody]], leaving Pauling and Tanner as the only survivors of the original crew. Cody, Solo, Chewbacca and the child [[Trig Longo]] all boarded the ''Freebird'' and it took off and left the ''Vector''. However, a zombie had somehow managed to get onboard the ship as well, and it killed Pauling and Tanner shortly after they had departed the Star Destroyer.
